proposals.evidence: Turner yuṣmad includes the Middle Indo-Aryan tumhe/tumhaṇa paradigm and Old Marwari thāharaü. Grierson’s historical Gujarati/Rajasthani table (Encyclopaedia Britannica 1911, XII p. 712) explicitly maps tumhe to Rajasthani thē and the oblique plural to thā̃. These survey thā/thā̃ you forms are compared with that paradigm, preserving their elicited use.
